_comment: HELLFALL architecture metrics standard (Docs/METRICS.md is the prose twin). Units: cm. Player-body values live in Data/movement.json; this file holds everything the level generator builds to. Tools/ue/build_greybox.py and build_feel_gym.py read this file; nothing here is duplicated in a script.
status: DRAFT — frozen only after Gate 1 approval

derived_rules.duct_passable_stance: crawl only: duct_interior_height (95) must exceed crawl_height (64) and be below crouch_height (116). Each duct mouth carries a duct_wall_thickness_cm (6) floor lip and head bar, so the clear mouth is 100 x 83; the engine clamps the crawl capsule to a 72 cm sphere (radius 36), leaving about 9 cm at the mouth and 23 cm inside. Feel-gym crawl tunnels have no lips.

encounter_space._comment: Gate 2 acceptance (REQ-G2-004) but the rooms must be sized for it in Gate 1 so the greybox is never reopened.
